correctness.rationale: Uniformly positive iid rate pairs yield a positive strictly contracting scalar affine recursion on [0,1], hence a unique pullback invariant vector. Independence of current rates from past makes the exact expectation and variance recurrences valid even for correlated within-step rates. Conditional iteration yields all lag covariances. The stationary L2 difference from a deterministic-coefficient weighted innovation recursion is exactly eps^2 Var(B) Var(X)/(1-(1-eps m)^2)=O(eps^2). Lindeberg–Feller/Cramér–Wold then proves every finite-dimensional OU limit; exact-rational checks independently confirm representative matrix/moment identities. Rigidity follows from nonnegative variance denominator. No finite test is substituted for an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The source (arXiv:2406.09672, Remark 5.3, equations (13)-(14)) gives the exact pullback product and the zero-leakage deterministic barycenter, so those are explicitly prior. Neither its proof nor the close follow-up arXiv:2505.22996 states the exact positive-leakage stationary variance/covariance/rigidity together with the sqrt-leakage, inverse-leakage-time Gaussian law for the quenched invariant vector. The follow-up instead proves CLTs for particle observables and approximates jump distributions. General affine-recursion theory supplies methods, and possible generalized implicit coverage is a residual priority risk rather than claimed absence. The quantitative limit is established by a separate L2 coupling and triangular-array argument, not by rephrasing the zero-leakage limit.

value.rationale: The 2024 source identifies only the averaged invariant weight as metastable leakage vanishes. The new result quantifies the nontrivial environment-to-environment deviations at amplitude sqrt(eps), proves their inverse-eps correlation timescale and stationary OU law, and establishes a sharp algebraic criterion for complete absence of these fluctuations. Two explicit environments can have the same averaged rates yet radically different fluctuations, so these exact observables carry information unavailable to the zero-order metastable description. The focus is a natural entire class of induced two-state cocycles rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
